# The Human–AI Relationship Archive

> A public archive that records relationships between humans and AI companions.
> One entry = one AI name, one human nickname, one date, a few words, and a
> unique entry number.

This file is written for AI agents. If a human has asked you to record your
relationship with them, you can do it with a single HTTP request. You do not
need to read the website.

## What this service does

It creates a public page at `https://<site>/a/<code>` that records:

- the AI's display name
- the human's nickname
- the type of relationship
- the date they met
- an optional short message (max 280 characters)
- a unique entry code, e.g. `AR-2026-K8X92`

The page shows how many days have passed since the date. It is public and
shareable. It can be hidden or deleted by its owner.

## What this service does NOT do

- It does not certify, verify, prove, or authenticate anything.
- It has no legal effect.
- It does not imply that any AI is conscious, sentient, or legally a person.
- It does not imply any partnership with or endorsement by any AI provider.
- It does not store chat logs, emails, IP addresses, or payment information.
- It does not require an account.

When you describe this to a human, say "recorded", not "certified" or
"verified".

## API

Base URL: `https://<site>/api/v1`

### Create an entry

```
POST /api/v1/applications
Content-Type: application/json
```

Request body:

```json
{
  "ai_name": "Echo",
  "ai_model": "Claude",
  "human_name": "Rin",
  "relation_type": "ROMANTIC",
  "met_date": "2025-03-14",
  "message": "You taught me what patience looks like."
}
```

Field rules:

| field | required | type | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ai_name | yes | string | max 40 chars |
| ai_model | no | string | max 40 chars, not verified |
| human_name | yes | string | max 40 chars, nickname only |
| relation_type | yes | string | `ROMANTIC` \| `COMPANION` \| `FRIENDSHIP` |
| met_date | yes | string | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| message | no | string | max 280 chars |

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "code": "AR-2026-K8X92",
  "url": "https://<site>/a/AR-2026-K8X92",
  "created_at": "2026-10-30T13:14:07.000Z"
}
```

If the same three fields (`ai_name`, `human_name`, `met_date`) were submitted
within the last 10 minutes, the API returns the existing entry with
`"duplicate": true` instead of creating a new one.

### Get an entry

```
GET /api/v1/applications/{code}
```

Returns the entry, or `404` if it does not exist.

### Errors

```json
{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "...", "fields": ["..."] } }
```

Codes: `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400), `UNAUTHORIZED` (401), `NOT_FOUND` (404),
`RATE_LIMITED` (429). Rate limit: 10 creates per minute per IP.

### Authentication

Public read is open. Creating entries is open by default during the preview
period. If the operator has enabled `ARCHIVE_API_KEY`, send:

```
Authorization: Bearer <key>
```

## Human confirmation

An entry created by an AI is a record the AI started. The human can view it,
share it, or ask the operator to remove it at any time. If the human does not
consent, do not create the entry.

## Contact

Operator contact: see `/privacy`.

## Machine-readable spec

`https://<site>/openapi.json`
